executive_finding.first_observable_anomaly: Unrelaxed Pressure Correction (p') hitting Poisson solver limit (p_limit = 9.1875 Pa) at Iteration 1
executive_finding.first_numerical_limiter_activation: Pressure-Correction Limiter (p_limit = 9.1875 Pa) at Iteration 1 (both Exp A and B)
executive_finding.first_velocity_limiter_activation: Max Velocity Cap (U_limit = 2.50 m/s) at Iteration 2 (Exp A) and Iteration 23 (Exp B)
executive_finding.causal_explanation: The unrelaxed pressure correction Poisson solver in Phase 3 encounters extreme cell mass imbalances on Iteration 1, forcing raw p' to saturate at p_limit = 9.1875 Pa immediately. This saturated p' creates severe cell pressure gradients grad(p'), which feed large velocity corrections du = -alpha_u * grad(p') / aP, rapidly accelerating boundary cells until the velocity cap (2.50 m/s) saturates in subsequent iterations (Iter 2 in Exp A, Iter 23 in Exp B). Because both pressure and velocity are clipped by artificial numerical bounds, physical mass and momentum conservation cannot be satisfied, culminating in residual degradation and force oscillations.

execution_order_proven: 4. Turbulent Viscosity nut Evaluation and Under-Relaxation (Phase 1)
6. Intermediate Velocity Predictor u*, v*, w* (Phase 2)
10. Pressure Poisson Linear Solve & Cell p' Limiter (Phase 3/4, p_limit = 9.1875 Pa)
11. Relaxed Pressure Update p = p + clamp(alpha_p * p', maxDeltaPAllowed) (Phase 4)
12. Cell Pressure Correction Gradient grad(p') Computation (Phase 4)
13. Velocity Correction du, dv, dw & Velocity Clamp U_limit = 2.50 m/s (Phase 4)
14. Corrected Face Fluxes & Mass Flow Balance (Phase 4)

pressure_correction_audit.unrelaxed_vs_relaxed_proof: In Iteration 1, the Poisson solver encounters raw_p_new > 9.1875 Pa in multiple cells, clamping p_prime to 9.1875. The solver records maxDeltaP = max(|p_prime|) = 9.1875. Then deltaP = clamp(alpha_p * p_prime, -1.225, 1.225) applies exactly 1.225 Pa to the pressure field. Hence pressureCorrection = 9.1875 is the unrelaxed Poisson cap, NOT a natural unconstrained result.

velocity_limiter_audit.nature: Hard artificial ceiling imposed on cell velocity magnitude to prevent numerical explosion from pressure correction gradients.

k_omega_residual_audit.kResidual_one_point_zero_explanation: In Experiment B, kResidual = 1.0 is a normalization artifact of the Gauss-Seidel solver when the initial residual equals the reference norm (rhsNorm) or when the solver terminates in 0 sweeps due to absoluteTolerance satisfaction on an extremely small baseline field. It represents normalized initial residual (r0 / r0 = 1.0) rather than a physical divergence to 1.0.
k_omega_residual_audit.omegaResidual_explanation: Omega linear solve smoothly reduces residual from initial ~1.0 to 1e-4 across successive sweeps.

telemetry_independence.continuityL1_accumulation: sum(|mass_defect|) / totalFaceThroughput evaluated over all cells independently in Phase 10.
telemetry_independence.momentumL1_accumulation: sum(|momentum_defect|) / (U_ref * inletMassFlow) evaluated over all momentum equations independently in Phase 10.

numerical_limiter_inventory.name: Poisson Cell Pressure Correction Limiter (p_limit)
numerical_limiter_inventory.formula: p_new = max(-p_limit, min(p_limit, raw_p_new)), p_limit = 3*q_inf / alpha_p
numerical_limiter_inventory.reason: Prevents unbounded divergence in pressure Poisson solver during early severe mass defect iterations.

numerical_limiter_inventory.name: Applied Pressure Correction Clamp (maxDeltaPAllowed)
numerical_limiter_inventory.reason: Limits maximum pressure change per SIMPLE outer iteration.

numerical_limiter_inventory.name: Velocity Correction Component Clamp (maxVelCorrAllowed)
numerical_limiter_inventory.reason: Prevents velocity correction from exceeding 50% free-stream speed in a single step.

numerical_limiter_inventory.name: Global Cell Speed Magnitude Ceiling (maxV_cap)
numerical_limiter_inventory.formula: speed = sqrt(u^2 + v^2 + w^2); if (speed > 2.50) scale_to_2.50()
numerical_limiter_inventory.reason: Hard numerical ceiling preventing velocity divergence in recirculation and boundary layer zones.

numerical_limiter_inventory.name: Turbulent Viscosity Ceiling (nut_max)
numerical_limiter_inventory.reason: Bounds eddy viscosity to maximum realizable turbulent ratio (10,000 * laminar viscosity).

numerical_limiter_inventory.name: SST k and omega Lower Bound Floors
numerical_limiter_inventory.reason: Prevents negative turbulence quantities and division by zero in eddy viscosity formulation.
